title: Jannini asks the court to let them exhume Chereze to study the bacteria

tellings.quote: after 30 yearsini is suggesting and requesting authorization from the court.

plain: Some thirty years after the 1996 events in the Brazilian town of Varginha, where strange beings were reportedly captured, a doctor named Jannini is said to be asking a court for permission to dig up the body of a man named Chereze, who is linked to those events, to study bacteria in his remains. Ahmed Foratu, a witness to the Varginha story, relays this on Jesse Michels's show, saying Jannini is "requesting authorization from the court".
